title: MissionWatch Live Mission Control configuration
description: Stream links and mission settings for the /live page. Types mirror src/app/features/live/live.models.ts.

_help.description: Notes for whoever edits this file. Ignored by the app.

missions.description: The first mission is shown by default. More than one adds a mission selector.

isoTime.description: ISO-8601 time, e.g. 2026-11-14T12:00:00Z. Leave empty if unknown.

id.description: Unique key, used in the ?mission= query parameter.

name.description: Leave empty to use the mission name from Launch Library 2.

vehicle.description: Leave empty to use the rocket from Launch Library 2.

launch.description: Where the countdown, status and timeline come from.

ll2LaunchId.description: Launch Library 2 launch UUID (the id in /launches/<id> on this site). Pins a specific launch.

nextFromProvider.description: When no ll2LaunchId is set, follow this provider's next upcoming launch, e.g. SpaceX.

fallbackT0.description: T-0 used only if launch data cannot be loaded at all.

events.description: Optional. When non-empty, replaces the Launch Library 2 timeline.

xDiscussionUrl.description: Post whose replies form the X discussion. Defaults to the X stream's post.

broadcaster.description: Shown on the panel for attribution.

video.description: YouTube URL, 11-character video ID, or YouTube's <iframe> embed code. Empty when no stream is announced yet.

channelUrl.description: Opened when the stream cannot be played inline, e.g. https://www.youtube.com/@Channel/live

broadcastUrl.description: x.com/i/broadcasts/... link or X's <blockquote class="twitter-broadcast"> embed code.

postUrl.description: x.com/<user>/status/<id>. Embedded when there is no broadcast.

profileUrl.description: Opened when nothing more specific is configured.

actualAt.description: Set only once confirmed by an authoritative source.
